doc.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Opening and current work with Nancy Wilson
summary: Introduction, and McCurdy's current touring with Nancy Wilson after sixteen years.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive here in New York City. My name is Monk Rowe, and we’re very pleased to have with us jazz drummer Roy McCurdy. Welcome.
Thanks for coming, and I know you’ve been traveling quite a bit lately. Can you bring us up to date on what you’re doing with your career right now?

Well right now, well I’m still working with Nancy Wilson. You know I’ve been doing her, working with Nancy for sixteen years. So I’m still doing that. We’re just getting ready to do a concert tonight. We just came from Boston actually four days ago, and I just stayed up there and spent some time with my wife. She’s up there doing a movie. And I just came in this morning.
And where do you go from here?
We have a concert tomorrow at Toledo, Ohio, and then Saturday we’ll be back in Los Angeles.
